patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BigCommerce and Lightspeed Retail share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BigCommerce only if your buying job matches “Open-SaaS ecommerce platform — Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ($79), Scale $399 ($2” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than BigCommerce's shape. Workflow advantage: BigCommerce leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b; Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BigCommerce and Lightspeed Retail share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BigCommerce is Open-SaaS ecommerce platform — Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ($79), Scale $399 ($299); GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees; Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe.
- Company-size focus: BigCommerce (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Lightspeed Retail (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: BigCommerce-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b vs Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: BigCommerce — 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription; Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path.

Limitations — BigCommerce: 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription; Native POS/retail depth trails Shopify/Square for omnichannel-first merchants; Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live.

Poor-fit cases: BigCommerce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription · Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · Avoid BigCommerce if you actually need Lightspeed Retail's motion (Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
